scenario: [LGRA.6.8]: two rules in one file share the name `alarm`, so the compiler refuses the program with DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_RULE. The two bodies differ, so neither is a harmless repeat of the other. PATH PINNED: the compilation-unit rule-name check over the root file alone, with no library loaded. Does not pin the cross-file halves, which are LGRA.6.8_file_and_library and LGRA.6.8_two_libraries.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule alarm:
    Trig t where t.v > 10
->
    log info "high"

rule alarm:
    Trig t where t.v < 0
->
    log info "low"
